theme: MECHANICAL FLOW / STRUCTURE (levered-ETF rebalance, non-CEF stale-NAV premium/discount, closing-auction print dislocation, distribution-reinvestment timing, creation/redemption pressure, cross-sectional month/quarter-end)

daily_panel.source: Alpaca SIP daily raw+adjusted bars and official auction prints, 185 ETFs

intraday_panel.source: research/data/rv_cache 5-minute bars (137 names) + t3_cache auction prints

costs.roundtrip_rule: overnight and intraday books are fully liquidated daily -> turnover charged at 2x gross per day

best.name: C2_AUCT_RESID_ON
best.desc: cross-section of 137 names: fade the closing-auction print's dislocation from the 15:55 price, residualised cross-sectionally each day on the last-30-minute return (T3's own feature), held closing auction -> next opening auction
why_not: design 1.667 is below the programme-cumulative bar of 1.925 for its panel and below its own family's empirical p95 of 1.811

UNEXECUTABLE: signal is the closing auction clearing price and entry is that same print; strictly executable re-timings give gross -1.80/-1.05 (open->close) and +0.57/+0.10 (open->open), both net negative; lagged-MOC variant C7 gives +0.78/-0.35
ARTEFACT: placebo marking the entry at the 15:55 price instead of the shared auction print flips design gross Sharpe from +4.26 to -6.16 and holdout from +2.78 to -5.08
the dislocation is 84% autocorrelated at lag 1 (rho=0.838, n=167097), i.e. a slow per-symbol measurement offset rather than an auction pricing error

best_non_artefact.name: A6_LETF_ASYM_XS
best_non_artefact.desc: fade retail levered-ETF positioning: short the underlying families whose long-levered share of family dollar volume is high against their own 60d norm, dollar-neutral across 15 families, 1-day hold
best_non_artefact.note: net-positive in both windows with no shared-price contamination and a 3x cost margin, but 0.79 against a 1.467 bar -- roughly a quarter of the noise bar. Recorded as the honest ceiling of the theme, not as a candidate.

harness_bugs_found_and_fixed: round-trip books (overnight close->open, intraday 15:30->close) were charged |w_t - w_{t-1}| instead of 2x gross per day; fixing it moved A1 from +0.54 to -0.96 and B4 from -3.52 to -5.56
the raw auction print feed was divided by the split/dividend back-adjusted rv_cache; fixed exactly on the daily panel via adj_close/raw_close and by a trailing 21d median ratio intraday
large negative Sharpes in the buggy run looked like sign-flip discoveries but were pure cost (flipping a book gives -gross - 2*cost); every row now reports gross, cost and break-even
dead_ledger_additions: levered-ETF close rebalancing flow (8 formulas) -- +0.79 bp/day gross vs a 2.00 bp/day round-trip floor, break-even 0.40x the universe's own half-spread; intensity and move-size gates make it worse
levered-ETF retail-positioning asymmetry -- best honest formula in the pass at 0.79/+0.35, a quarter of the noise bar
non-CEF stale-NAV premium/discount, bond and international wrappers (6) -- gross never exceeds 0.62 bp/day against >=1.0 bp/day of cost
closing-auction print dislocation (4+3) -- shared-price measurement-error artefact, and unexecutable by construction
distribution-reinvestment timing, bond-ETF ex-week yield sort -- gross +0.24 bp/day design, +0.03 holdout
creation/redemption own-volume anomaly vs same-exposure siblings -- gross +0.04 bp/day against 2.84 bp/day of cost, and a bad gate on live leg L2
month/quarter-end as a cross-sectional flow gate -- F1/F2/F3 each worse than the ungated formula they gate
